## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4fdec4335c99f888689c73d89141e568bd996938`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md + none

Read: card #32856 (body and its one comment, claim 6837814181, with the 22:06Z rules 1–5 as quoted in the brief), PR #32894 (body, 3-file list, net diff against `main`; merge base = `origin/main` 5fb79bc0), and the 47 check-runs on this head: 22 success, 25 skipped, 0 failed, 0 in progress at the last read (the three Lint jobs that were still running at first read, including `Lint · repo & tooling gates` which carries `check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, completed success). The PR is still a draft. Ruling 6830795926 (PR #32845) was not read: it is outside the inputs; only its effect on the tree (ba321c27 put epic child cards on the `xhigh` line) was read.

### ① Derived judgments

1. execution-duties :37–38 — between "before the PR" and "after a sibling lands" no chasing `main`; `behind` is no reason; merge only on conflict, a `main`-caused red or a queue kick-out; before enqueue by the K bar and section A. **Right**: it is rule 1 and AGENTS.md §10, and agrees with landing-operations :29, :37 (`dirty`), :41 (K ≥ 15 / new locale bundle, "`behind` 例外"), platform-readings :88 and dispatch-runbook :225.
2. :38 「派发令与复读请求 ⛔ 不令主动合;合后只重跑 AGENTS.md §10 所划受影响门禁,⛔ 不跑全套」 — the first two clauses **right**; the closing 「⛔ 不跑全套」 is **wrong as an absolute** (see ④ S1).
3. landing-operations :101 — a relay leg's 「全套验证」 becomes the §10 scoped set. **Right**: the card orders it; in the D case (legs sharing generated files) §10's own overlap branch still yields the full run, so nothing is lost.
4. :127–128 — L moves from `xhigh` to `high`; nit rework joins `medium`; p1 no longer raises effort; the `xhigh` list outranks the line above. **Right** (rule 2). No other text in `.claude/**` or AGENTS.md orders `xhigh` for p1 or L (security-findings :27 and the checklist-test skill name security fixes only; seat-lifecycle :39 is session effort).
5. :129 — a card thread opens at its build effort, fixed at spawn; design and red-line re-reads go to an isolated `xhigh` subagent. **Right** (rule 2; the card's "effort is fixed at spawn" premise).
6. :130 — 「拿不准升一档」 on the triage-suggestion line. **Right**: kept, and adjacent to the effort lines it governs.
7. :166–167 — the in-flight ≤45 min interval now binds every seat, not only Routine seats; idle seats are event-woken with a 4–6 h fallback patrol running the five standby items; ⛔ 60–70 min. **Right**: rule 3 says "unchanged while in flight" and "never 60–70"; the only prior project-seat number was the hourly default at seat-post-protocol :65, which the same rule forbids, so ≤45 is the one in-flight number the tree held. It is a real change for project seats in flight (60 → ≤45) and the 速读 says so.
8. seat-post-protocol :65 — 「默认每小时」 becomes a pointer to 收集节②; 「放宽注由」 kept. **Right**: one home for the number; seat-lifecycle :92 already points at the same line.
9. :33 and :49 — a serialized later card, a card whose PR would stack on an unmerged PR, and a card with an unmerged `Blocked-by:` open no thread until the merge; maintainer order excepted at :49. **Right** (rule 4). It binds card threads only; an in-seat subagent for an S card is not named, as in the order.
10. :122 — every execution and triage seat session at the default judgment tier; the contract tier only per card through an isolated subagent or a card thread. **Right** (rule 5). :104–107 and :110 are untouched, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` is not in the diff, so published `skills/**` stays contract tier.
11. Five same-file dedupes pay for the five added lines — judged one by one in ③.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` matches: the diff is three files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**`, nothing published, no package touched; `Check Changeset` is green on this head.

Clause-②: no — correct. No published accepted set is widened and no public surface grows; `Metadata-protocol: none` is likewise correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev flags:

1. 22:06Z wording over the card's — **answered, holds**. The claim's ruling zone says the 22:06Z wording governs where the two differ. Three explicit merge triggers, the five standby checks on the fallback patrol and the in-flight interval are all in rule 1 and rule 3 as quoted. The every-seat reading of the in-flight interval is ① item 7.
2. Epic child cards kept on the `xhigh` list — **answered, no conflict with rule 2; one question escalated**. Rule 2 names what is `xhigh` and removes exactly one thing by name (p1) and one by placement (L under M/L `high`); it neither names nor removes epic child cards. The entry came in with ba321c27 the same day; deleting a ruled entry on silence would be the larger derivation, and the card's own Part 2 text predates that merge. Because keeping it is the costlier reading of a cost-cutting order, the seat should put one line to the maintainer: does rule 2 retire epic child cards from `xhigh`? Not blocking.
3. 「节奏维护者明示可改」 not restated — **answered, holds**. Rule 3 does not carry the clause; a Routine seat's cron stays the maintainer's knob at seat-post-protocol :64 (and lanes/eval.md :7); the maintainer's power to change a project seat's cadence needs no line.
4. Citations in the PR body, not the skill lines — **answered, accepted with a correction; escalated to the seat's ACCEPT**. The card's acceptance says each part cites the maintainer's 2026-11-12 words in the skill text; that bullet is unmet as written. The stated reason is overstated on the tree: :129 is 94 bytes and :130 is 85, so two lines have headroom. See ④ S3.
5. Part 4's half-line on :33 rather than the card's ":33" — **answered, holds**. The card's line numbers were on an older `main`; the sentence sits on the fold-or-serial answer line, which is where a serial answer is recorded.

The five paying cuts (each checked against the tree at this head):

1. old :17 + :24 → :23. Dropped 「`batch` 等待不填槽,四态」 — in force at SKILL.md :59 (the four waiting states hold no slot). Dropped 「p0 越过 `batch`、深度等待与一切并发上限」 — in force verbatim at SKILL.md :118. **No rule lost.**
2. old :43 + :44 → :44. The `ui/**` remainder rule survives whole. Dropped 「自拆只对整落 `ui/**` 外他车道树的卡自列独立项」 — self-split for other-lane items is at :42 and `ui/**` is excluded at :44; the positive 「整落」 qualifier now appears only at :72 (the `Release:` line). **Rule in force; definition thinner** (nit N3).
3. :49. Dropped 「`pm:blocking` 在其车道排最前」 — the label order at :53 and the fan-out rule at :56 are the authority (and are more exact: p0 precedes). Dropped 「等待者写该卡;p0/p1 沿链传递」 — in force at dispatch-runbook :175. **No rule lost.**
4. old :155 + :156 → :156. Dropped 「归档义务只落在云卡」 — landing-operations :78–79 state the archive duty for `mode:cloud` sessions. Dropped 「席位看不见其会话」 — dispatch-runbook 云卡五课 五 ④. **No rule lost**; the OOM clause changed neighbours (nit N4).
5. old :174 + :175 → :175. The posture sentence is in dispatch-runbook 停摆复位梯度. Dropped the explicit 「⛔ 不等任何静默阈值(阈值是给没有回答的)」; what remains is 「立刻 SendMessage」. **Rule in force through 「立刻」; the named failure mode is gone** (nit N5).

No rule is lost by the cuts. None is a re-wrap: every merged pair dropped stated content.

### ④ Design judgment

Budgets, read off the tree: execution-duties 190 lines, landing-operations 107, seat-post-protocol 88; longest line in each is 120 bytes; no ceiling row moved (`scripts/**` is not in the diff); no new line carries an issue number. The CI job that runs the ratchet and id-lint is green on this head.

Part by part against the card and rules 1–5:

- Part 1 — holds. K ≥ 15 / new locale bundle (landing-operations :39–42) and section A regenerate are kept by reference on :37; D reads as the scoped set. One over-statement, S1.
- Part 2 — holds. 「拿不准升一档」 kept (:130, and :102 for tiers); standing `xhigh` for security (:128) and ADR amendments (:104) unchanged.
- Part 3 — holds. Idle is defined on :167; seat-lifecycle :87 (⛔ no stopping on N fires without change) is untouched and still binds; the fallback patrol runs the five standby items, which include the `pm:blocked` / `pm:on-hold` unlock scan (seat-lifecycle :93), so a `Restart-when:` that comes true is read within 4–6 h. One ambiguity, S2.
- Part 4 — holds. Section C draft parking is untouched; the concurrency cap is untouched (SKILL.md :59, coordinator.md 三); the maintainer-ordered build-ahead is on :49.
- Part 5 — holds. See ① item 10.

Contradiction sweep of `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` and AGENTS.md for a 60-min patrol default, a merge on `behind`, `xhigh` for every p1, or a skills seat at the contract tier: none found in skill text or AGENTS.md. lanes/skills.md :25 (「pm-dispatch 根恒契约复审档」) is a card tier, not a session tier. dispatch-runbook 卡线程 (「M 及以上、p1、security 卡一卡一线程」) is about threads, not effort. contract-review :24, landing-operations :87 and project-forms :50 use "约 60 分钟" for a triage round or a knock cadence, not an execution seat's patrol interval. What was found is S4 and N6.

Findings — must-fix: none.

Should-fix:

- **S1** execution-duties :38 「⛔ 不跑全套」. Neither the card nor rule 1 says this; both say "only the §10 scoped re-checks". AGENTS.md §10's scoped set includes a full `pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` when the incoming commits touch the same packages or behaviour, or a conflict fell outside trivially mechanical files. Read literally, the line forbids what §10 orders in exactly that case, and dispatch orders are written from this line. The line names §10 as the measure and CI backstops, so it is not a must-fix; drop the clause or make it conditional (the line is 119 bytes; dropping it frees room).
- **S2** execution-duties :167 「探针空手即收工」 beside :166 「兜底巡查…跑待命五项」. seat-lifecycle :92 makes the probe the first step of a patrol, before the five items; a seat can read :167 as ending a fallback patrol before the unlock scan, which is the one read the card says a mail-only wake cannot replace. The wording mirrors rule 3, and :166 is explicit that the fallback patrol runs the five items, so it holds; one word saying the empty-handed exit is for an event wake, or comes after the five items, removes the reading (:167 has 6 bytes spare).
- **S3** Acceptance bullet "each citing the maintainer's 2026-11-12 words" is unmet in the skill text, and the PR body's reason (no headroom on any line) is not true of :129 and :130. The rules themselves are correct without it and the provenance is on the card and this PR. The seat's ACCEPT must name this deviation and accept it or send it back; the reviewer does not waive an acceptance line.
- **S4** (outside the diff and outside the claim's file surface — a follow-up card, not this PR) `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` H70 and H71 finding sentences still say a project seat runs a "self-bound hourly patrol routine" and "an hourly patrol", and H71's two-hour clock is justified as "one missed fire plus slack". Both rows are report-only and neither judges the cron value, so nothing blocks; but their prose now contradicts :166–167 and seat-post-protocol :65, and an idle lane on a 4–6 h fallback will show H71 at 2 h.

Nit:

- **N1** :127 drops 「(默认)」 and 「施工与修门禁」 from the card's wanted sentence. 「M、L `high`」 covers building and gate fixes on those sizes and :126 forbids leaving effort blank, so no card is left without an answer.
- **N2** :38 names 「派发令与复读请求」; the card also named the brief.
- **N3** cut 2: the 「整落」 qualifier for self-split survives only at :72.
- **N4** cut 4: 「OOM 死者单独重派;判定连档位记认领」 now follows the `start_session` clause instead of the build-heavy container line (:155) it belonged to.
- **N5** cut 5: the explicit ⛔ against waiting on a silence threshold is reduced to 「立刻」.
- **N6** two older lines now read against a seat that is never at the contract tier, both resolved by :123: SKILL.md :201 「本席按达档自审」 and contract-review :20–21 「达档者席内审」. Separately, seat-post-protocol :18 lists when the stub is refreshed and does not name a patrol-cron change, while :65 asks for the note. Follow-up material, same card as S4 if the maintainer wants it.
